w01.why: Four rows of ten stepped blocks filled with uniform vertical hatching; the hatching is fill texture rather than an alternation of the values, and the blocks change level irregularly without a standout moment.

w02.why: Clusters of marks rise and fall the same way in every grid cell, about sixty times in all, and the last two cells of most rows sit lower, a slower pattern repeated about nine times.

w03.why: A 40-column grid of dot-filled cells forming a broad shape (a high block at right, a dip in the middle), with no rhythmic repetition and no single standout moment; the ruler at the bottom is excluded.

w04.why: Groups of bands rise and fall in every cell, about sixty times, and the first two cells of each row (shaded) hold weaker, lower rises, a slower pattern repeated about nine times.

w05.why: A wavy line rises and falls about seven times per row across nine rows (about sixty humps), and the first two humps of each row are lower, a slower pattern repeated about nine times.

w06.why: A 40-column grid of shaded cells with dot glyphs forming a broad shape with no rhythmic repetition; the tick rows are excluded and the small mark at lower left is an unreadable scribble.

w07.why: About sixty small tiles each repeat the same arch of bands, and in the upper five rows the sixth and seventh tiles show a lower, flatter arch, a slower pattern repeated about five times.

w08.why: Dots trace about seven humps per row across nine rows (about sixty in all), and the first two humps of each row stay lower, a slower pattern repeated about nine times.

w09.why: A 40-column grid of gray cells forming a broad silhouette with no evenly repeating rise and fall; the tick marks below are excluded.

w10.why: Forty blurred vertical columns of varying extent and tone with no regular repeating pattern and no single standout moment; the fine stripes and ticks are texture and ruler.

w11.why: Nine stacked wavy lines each rise and fall about seven times (about sixty humps), but no slower even rhythm between the humps is visible and nothing stands out as singular.

w12.why: Forty columns of dotted vertical ranges forming a broad shape (high at right, low dip in the middle) without regular repetition or one singular moment; the background grid is excluded.
